title: Can Entry-Wise Clipping Give Spectral Control of Stochastic Gradients?
abstract: arXiv:2605.27733v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training instabilities such as loss spikes are frequently the result of stochastic gradient noise. Because of rare expressions in language training data, and multiple layer composition, the noise impact is heavy-tailed and survives mini-batch averaging. Existing remedies trade off structure against cost: vector-norm clipping ignores the matrix structure of weight updates, while spectral normalization (e.g., Muon (Jordan et al., 2024)) respects it at additional cost. We show that this trade-off can be balanced. Real gradient noise appears to be similar to entry-wise heavy-tailed contamination, and a first-order perturbation analysis reveals a localization property of such noise, under which a simple entry-wise method achieves spectral control. Exploiting this, we derive a tractable surrogate for the Bayes-optimal entry-wise estimator under a Gaussian signal prior. We establish $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ convergence guarantee under Cauchy-c

translated_title: 逐元素裁剪能否实现对随机梯度的谱控制？
translated_abstract: 训练不稳定性（如损失突增）常常是随机梯度噪声的结果。由于语言训练数据中存在稀有表达，加上多层网络的复合作用，噪声影响呈重尾分布，并且在小批量平均后依然存在。现有的补救措施在结构与代价之间进行权衡：向量范数裁剪忽略了权重更新的矩阵结构，而谱归一化（例如 Muon (Jordan et al., 2024)）虽然尊重这种结构，却需要额外代价。我们证明这种权衡是可以平衡的。真实的梯度噪声似乎类似于逐元素的重尾污染，一阶扰动分析揭示了此类噪声的局域化特性，在此特性下，一种简单的逐元素方法即可实现谱控制。利用这一点，我们推导出在高斯信号先验下贝叶斯最优逐元素估计器的一个可求解的替代形式，并在柯西污染假设下建立了 $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 的收敛保证。
tldr: 本文提出一种简单的逐元素裁剪方法，能够以低成本实现对重尾随机梯度噪声的谱控制，从而平衡矩阵结构感知与计算开销之间的权衡，缓解训练中的损失突增等不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: A simple entry-wise clipping method achieves spectral control of heavy-tailed stochastic gradient noise, balancing the trade-off between respecting matrix structure and computational cost, with O(ε^{-4}) convergence guarantees under Cauchy contamination.
